title: An ID selects a row, not a meaning
purpose: Separate learned table capacity from the four values copied for one token.
contract: Canonical E [3,4], strides [4,1], F32; token 1 selects row 1.
Element offsets [4,5,6,7] correspond to byte displacements [16,20,24,28].
